metrics.name: in_steered_total
metrics.help: IPIP packets from an l4lb front to a VIP port owned by a pod, decapped and redirected into the pod.

metrics.name: in_not_lb_src_total
metrics.help: IPIP packets whose outer source is not a known l4lb front (left to the kernel).

metrics.name: in_no_port_total
metrics.help: IPIP packets from an l4lb front to a VIP port no pod owns (left to the kernel).

metrics.name: in_err_total
metrics.help: Inbound packets dropped because a rewrite helper failed.

metrics.name: out_snat_total
metrics.help: Pod replies SNATed back to the VIP and sent out of the bound interface.

metrics.name: out_err_total
metrics.help: Pod replies dropped because a rewrite helper failed.

metrics.name: steered_ports
metrics.help: VIP ports currently steered into pods.
